title: The Heavenly Gate Opens
next_chapter_hook: The words left behind by the gatekeeper when he departed coiled around Chen Ji's heart like a venomous snake—"The laws of the Heavenly Realm were never meant for those of the mortal realm. You are, after all, merely an ant that strayed into the immortal paradise." And now, that gaze hidden in the depths of the void seemed to grow several times more intense...

text.content:
The heavens were ink-black, thunderclouds churning.

Chen Ji stood before the fissure that cleaved the earth and sky, beneath his feet were blackened rocks split by the tribulation lightning, behind him were the terrified gazes of the three sect alliance. He did not turn around, merely gazing quietly at the entrance emanating chaotic energy before him—the Heavenly Realm.

An intangible pressure surged forth from the depths of the fissure, like ten thousand mountains pressing down simultaneously. Chen Ji felt his bones creaking, blood flowing backward through his meridians. This was the Heavenly Realm's natural rejection of outsiders, the most primal warning from this world.

"Mm..."

Chen Ji groaned, falling to one knee. At his fontanelle, his veins bulged grotesquely, sweat dripping from his jaw. The Heavenly Realm's suppression was more terrifying than he had imagined, as if an invisible hand was crushing this intruder alive.

However, at this critical moment, the Heavenly Eye Pupil at his brow center suddenly throbbed. A profound and mysterious perception surged from that fragment, allowing him to instantly perceive the true nature of this pressure—not merely suppression, but a trial, a selection.

dialogue.content:
"So that's how it is... The laws of the Heavenly Realm are no more than this."

Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, a nonchalant arc curling at the corner of his lips. He had seen through the essence of this trial—it was not aimed at cultivation level, but at temperament. The more one feared, the more one submitted, the more this pressure would crush one to bits.

And he, Chen Ji, had never been one to bow to fate.

text.content:
The Heavenly Eye Pupil slowly opened at Chen Ji's brow center, pitch-black pupils reflecting countless flowing law patterns. These were the materialized forms of the Heavenly Realm's laws, the most fundamental operating rules of this world. Chen Ji gazed at those patterns, inscribing them one by one into his mind.

At that moment, an aged yet arrogant voice drifted from the depths of the fissure:

"Oh? There's actually an ant still standing?"

The voice exploded like thunder, carrying indisputable authority. A hunched figure slowly materialized from the void, draped in tattered battle armor, clutching a rust-eaten halberd. His face was carved with the marks of time, yet his eyes blazed with brilliant light, like two small suns.

dialogue.content:
"I've guarded this gate for thirty thousand years, yet this is the first time I've encountered such an audacious creature."

The elder swept Chen Ji with a glance, his eyes full of contempt. He walked forward slowly, each step making the void beneath his feet tremble, his imposing manner reaching an terrifying extreme.

"A mere Golden Core stage ant dares to covet the Heavenly Realm? How could the gates of heaven be breached by trash like you?"

He raised his halberd, its tip pointing directly at Chen Ji's brow center: "Get lost, or today I'll teach you the rules of the Heavenly Realm."

text.content:
Chen Ji did not move, merely gazing quietly at this overbearing gatekeeper. In his Heavenly Eye Pupil, the countless law patterns were rapidly assembling and deducing, giving him a clear view of the old man's true capabilities.

Void Spirit Realm pinnacle, lived at least fifty thousand years, combat power among the lowest in the Heavenly Realm, but due to his seniority, was casually appointed gatekeeper by the Heavenly Emperor.

Chen Ji sneered inwardly: So it's one of those old farts who coast on their age.

The corner of his lips slightly raised, that smile appearing as a great insult to the gatekeeper.

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond to the Heavenly Realm gatekeeper's arrogance and threats?

choices.description: With a mortal body, hard resist the suppression of Heavenly Realm's laws, showcasing unyielding will, proving through actions that he is absolutely not an ant.
choices.visible_reward: The Heavenly Eye Pupil further awakens, gaining the passive skill "Law Resistance"
choices.risk_hint: May suffer more fierce law backlash

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, pushing his entire body's True Qi to its limit. The Heavenly Realm's laws were like a狂暴的primordial beast, savagely tearing at his meridians, every inch of skin enduring tearing agony.

Yet, his spine remained perfectly straight.

dialogue.content:
"I, Chen Ji, have never bowed my head to anyone in this life—including this so-called heaven!"

As the words fell, the Heavenly Eye Pupil at Chen Ji's brow center suddenly blazed with magnificent golden light, colliding head-on with the Heavenly Realm's suppression. A visible shockwave erupted from within him, cracking countless fissures in the surrounding void.

choices.description: Directly display the power of the Tianji Record, forcibly breakthrough with means far beyond the other's comprehension, showcasing the protagonist's absolute confidence and overwhelming superiority.
choices.visible_cost: May expose part of the Tianji Record's abilities, potentially noticed by the Heavenly Dao's Eye
choices.visible_reward: The gatekeeper is instantly intimidated, gaining 50 Reputation points instantly, obtaining the item "Heavenly Realm Passage Permit"
choices.risk_hint: Tianji Record's aura leaks, may attract bigger trouble

text.content:
Chen Ji did not waste words, the Heavenly Eye Pupil at his brow center suddenly opened wide. A golden radiance shot forth from his brow center, carrying mysterious energy that transcended this world, rushing directly toward the gatekeeper's brow center.

The gatekeeper's pupils constricted, instinctively raising his halberd to block.

dialogue.content:
"This is... what!"

The moment the golden radiance struck the halberd, the gatekeeper was struck like lightning, his entire arm numbed from the vibration. He widened his eyes, staring at Chen Ji with utter disbelief, as if witnessing something inconceivable.

"Impossible! This aura... is it the 'Tianji Record'? The legendary..."

choices.description: Suppress the Heavenly Eye's power, present a useless persona to feign weakness, secretly observe to find weaknesses, resolve the crisis by playing the pig to eat the tiger.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily suppress strength, endure humiliation internally
choices.visible_reward: Gatekeeper relaxes vigilance, secretly obtain intelligence on Heavenly Realm entrance map and guard distribution
choices.risk_hint: May be seen as weak and suffer more humiliation

text.content:
Chen Ji sneered inwardly, but on the surface switched to an expression of panic. He quickly retreated two steps, bowed respectfully, his voice trembling as he said:

"Senior, please calm your anger! Junior... Junior merely strayed here accidentally, absolutely no coveting of the Heavenly Realm!"

He lowered his head, yet within his eyes flashed a cold glint that was not easily察觉.

dialogue.content:
The gatekeeper, seeing this, sneered: "Hmph, at least you know when to quit. Ants like you, I see dozens every year. Get lost, before I change my mind."

Chen Ji nodded and bowed as he retreated, but in truth had already inscribed the entrance terrain and guard distribution into his mind. The Heavenly Eye Pupil operated silently in his Mental Sea, organizing and archiving all this intelligence.

text.content:
The gatekeeper's halberd stopped three inches before Chen Ji, its tip's cold radiance almost piercing his skin. The old man stared into Chen Ji's eyes, seemingly searching for something.

After a moment, he withdrew his halberd, coldly harrumphing:

"Ants are ants, not even having the courage to resist. Fine, today I'm in a good mood, so I'll let you live. Get lost, before I change my mind."

Chen Ji did not speak, merely bowing slightly, turning to walk back the way he came. His steps were steady, his back appearing even somewhat lonely.

dialogue.content:
"Remember," the gatekeeper's voice came from behind, carrying undeniable authority, "the laws of the Heavenly Realm were never meant for those of the Heavenly Realm. You are, after all, merely an ant that strayed into the immortal paradise."

"Ant..."

Chen Ji repeated these two words silently in his heart, the corner of his lips slightly lifting. He did not look back, merely walking forward quietly.

Ant?

Very well.

Let these high-and-mighty existences continue thinking so.

text.content:
Just as Chen Ji was about to step out of the Heavenly Realm entrance, his footsteps suddenly halted.

A sensation of being watched had accompanied him since the moment he entered the Heavenly Realm, following like a shadow. That gaze was not from the gatekeeper, but from a more profound, more ancient place—as if an invisible pair of eyes was piercing through layers of void, scrutinizing him, this anomaly.

Chen Ji's heart missed a beat.

The Heavenly Eye Pupil疯狂跳动in his Mental Sea, seemingly passing him some kind of warning. And the gatekeeper's departing back, now appeared somewhat profound and meaningful.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the unease in his heart.

He knew where that gaze came from.

The Heavenly Dao's Eye.

That existence surpassing all else, perhaps at this moment in some unknown corner, was watching him, this ant who sought to defy heaven and change his fate.

But so what?

Chen Ji raised his head to gaze at that sky covered by thunderclouds, his eyes flashing with determination. He had come this far, and would not turn back.

Even if the path ahead was a bottomless abyss, he would personally trample it flat.

At that moment, a sudden mutation occurred.

At the Heavenly Realm entrance, the fissure that cleaved the earth and sky suddenly let out a world-shaking roar. Countless chaotic energy gushed forth from the fissure, transforming into grotesque strange beasts, lunging toward Chen Ji.

The gatekeeper's voice echoed in the void, carrying a hint of mockery:

"Forgot to tell you, the chaotic energy at the Heavenly Realm entrance attacks all intruders autonomously. If you want to leave alive, show your worth."

Chen Ji expressionlessly watched the approaching beast horde, yet in his heart was rapidly calculating.

choice.prompt: Chaotic strange beasts horde attacks, how should Chen Ji respond to this sudden trial?

choices.text: Strike with Full Force and Annihilate
choices.description: Display true strength, slay all these chaotic strange beasts, prove through strength that he is absolutely not an ant.
choices.visible_cost: Completely expose strength, may attract more attention

text.content:
Chen Ji's gaze turned cold, his right hand grabbing at the air. In an instant, a sword formed from pure sword energy appeared in his palm.

He did not动用the Tianji Record's power, merely relying on his own sword cultivation, facing the overwhelming beast horde.

dialogue.content:
"Sword comes!"

Chen Ji cried out lightly, sword light like a rainbow. One sword strike, and heaven and earth lost color. Those countless strange beasts before his sword fell like wheat being harvested, blood dyeing the entire scorched earth crimson.

A moment later, the beast horde was completely annihilated.

choices.text: Outsmart to Find Breaking Formation Method
choices.description: Use the Heavenly Eye Pupil to analyze the chaotic strange beasts' weaknesses, find the key nodes to break the formation, breakthrough the encirclement at minimum cost.
choices.visible_reward: Discover the chaotic energy's operating pattern, usable for subsequent planning
choices.risk_hint: Analysis requires time, may get injured during the process

text.content:
Chen Ji did not fight head-on, instead activating the Heavenly Eye Pupil to record the chaotic strange beasts' trajectories. Soon, he discovered the clue—these beasts appeared chaotic and disorganized, but actually followed a certain fixed formation.

And within the formation, there was a key node slowly gathering power.

dialogue.content:
"Found it."

A slight arc curved at Chen Ji's lips, his form flickering, directly appearing above that node. He struck out with his palm, directly hitting the beast formation's vital point. In an instant, the entire formation collapsed with a thunderous crash, those originally ferocious beasts instantly turning to nothingness.

choices.text: Borrow Force to Counter and Escape
choices.description: Use the chaotic strange beasts' power to rebound on them, return like for like, seek opportunities to escape amid the chaos.
choices.visible_cost: May leave hidden troubles, chaotic energy infiltrating the body
choices.visible_reward: Chaotic energy can be refined to strengthen the physique

text.content:
Chen Ji did not engage the strange beasts head-on, instead continuously moving and dodging, guiding their attacks toward each other.

The chaotic strange beasts slaughtered each other, the scene in utter chaos. Chen Ji took the opportunity to shuttle through the beast horde, appearing disheveled on the surface, but actually as stable as Mount Tai.

dialogue.content:
Before long, the beast horde was depleted from mutual slaughter. And on Chen Ji's body also adhered wisps of chaotic energy.

He allowed those gases to seep through his skin, slowly settling within his body. Although dangerous, if these chaotic energies could be refined, they would be of tremendous benefit to his physique.

text.content:
When the last strange beast fell, Chen Ji brushed the dust from his robes, his expression nonchalant.

His gaze passed through the Heavenly Realm entrance, looking toward that even more vast world. The silhouette of the Heavenly Realm loomed indistinct within the chaotic energy, like a sleeping giant beast, emanating heart-stopping pressure.

The gatekeeper's voice rang out again, this time carrying a hint of surprise:

"Oh? Actually didn't die? Underestimated you, this ant."

Chen Ji did not respond, merely standing quietly in place, raising his head to gaze at that celestial dome. His eyes were profound as an abyss, as if contemplating something.

dialogue.content:
"However, this is merely the first trial." The gatekeeper's voice carried a playful tone, "The Heavenly Realm has nine heavenly gates, each with different trials. If you wish to truly enter the Heavenly Realm, come step by step."

As the words fell, a crack opened in the void, and the gatekeeper's figure vanished within it.

Only leaving one sentence echoing in the wind:

"Ant, I await to see which gate you can reach."

text.content:
Chen Ji gazed at that vanishing crack, a meaningful arc curling at the corner of his lips.

Ant?

Very well.

He deeply branded these two words into his heart, then turned and stepped onto the road of return.

The first heavenly gate's trial, he had passed. But this was merely the beginning.

Nine gates of the Heavenly Realm, each，一道is a life-and-death barrier. And beyond those nine gates, there exists that existence surpassing all else—the Heavenly Dao's Eye, awaiting him.

But so what?

He, Chen Ji, has never feared any challenge.

Just as Chen Ji was about to step out of the Heavenly Realm entrance, that gaze like thorns on his back appeared again, several times more intense, more oppressive than before.

Chen Ji's footsteps slightly paused.

He could sense that within that gaze carried some scrutiny, some curiosity, and some... anticipation?

As if some existence was gazing through layers of void, watching with great interest this overreaching ant.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the chill in his heart. The Heavenly Dao's Eye... so it has already noticed him.

But this, instead made him more resolute.

The moment Chen Ji stepped out of the Heavenly Realm entrance, the chaotic fissure behind him slowly closed.

He stood on the scorched black rock, behind him were the gazes of the three sect alliance, mixed with terror and reverence. No one knew what he had experienced at the Heavenly Realm entrance, nor what had transpired between him and that gatekeeper.

They only knew that this废物, once mocked by all, had actually walked back alive from the Heavenly Realm entrance.

Chen Ji paid no attention to those complicated gazes, merely raising his head quietly to gaze at the sky.

There, he seemed to see a pair of无形eyes, piercing through layers of void, staring into his eyes.

"Heavenly Dao's Eye..."

Chen Ji silently recited this name in his heart, his eyes flashing with a sharp light.

He remembered. In a certain passage of the Tianji Record Fragment, this existence was mentioned. It was not some specific person, but the manifestation of the Heavenly Dao's will, one of the most fundamental rules of this world.

All prophetic seers throughout history were merely its chess pieces.

And the Tianji Record itself was merely one of the many chess pieces it had placed in the mortal world.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, temporarily setting aside this information. Now was not the time to resist; he needed more strength, more bargaining chips.

The words left behind by the gatekeeper when he departed coiled around Chen Ji's heart like a venomous snake—"The laws of the Heavenly Realm were never meant for those of the Heavenly Realm. You are, after all, merely an ant that strayed into the immortal paradise."

And now, that gaze hidden in the depths of the void seemed to grow several times more intense...
